hooks.prompt: Security-review this branch before the PR is created. Run `git diff` against the base branch and check it against Sparl's D10 security architecture: (1) every new or changed user-facing table has a household-scoped RLS policy (Clerk-JWT); (2) no secrets, keys, service_role, or credentials committed; (3) Supabase Storage access uses short-lived signed URLs, not public buckets; (4) no PII in logs; (5) every webhook endpoint verifies its signature in code and Zod-validates the payload after; (6) no client-side privileged DB access. Report any blockers as file:line with the rule violated, and BLOCK if a blocker is found. $ARGUMENTS
